_doc: relentless_wake.py (RELENTLESS_WIRE_WAKE_ON_STATE_CHANGE). mode live|off. Each cap is a rate cap against a trigger loop on the live tick unit, not a pause: a capped wake is served by rm-relentless.timer's heartbeat (15 s after a tick).
_fire_min_gap_s: Floor between two tick starts the wake makes. Measured 2026-11-06: a tick that does work takes 240-600 s (journal wall_s), so a real tick never meets this floor; only a tick that exits at once (disabled, integrity gate, crash) could restart in a loop, and 10 s bounds that to the heartbeat's own pace (15 s) or better.
_fire_max_per_hour: Ceiling on wake-made tick starts an hour. Measured 2026-11-06: importing relentless.py costs 0.25-0.34 s (3 runs) and `relentless_wake.py status` 0.02-0.05 s (5 runs); a tick that crashes at once under a poke storm thus costs at most 60 starts x ~0.3 s an hour, then the heartbeat alone runs it.
_serve_min_gap_s: Floor between two in-tick serves. A serve costs a books sync (measured 1.5 s, py_calls relentless:sync) plus an enrol with a fresh ledger read (measured 11.2 s, relentless:enrol): 20 s keeps a burst of landings to at most ~40% of a tick's time while a close still enrols its dependents within ~35 s.
_serve_max_per_tick: Ceiling on in-tick serves. Measured serve cost: books sync 1.5 s + enrol 11.2 s (py_calls), plus a flush of the tick's own ledger lines when sync refuses for them (live 2026-11-06: every mid-tick serve did; flush phase p50 10 s, max 90 s over 25 ticks): ~23 s, so 6 serves add at most ~140 s typical, bounded inside the 1200 s unit timeout.
_clock_keys: Every relentless_rules.json key that is still a clock after RELENTLESS_WIRE_WAKE_ON_STATE_CHANGE, with the measured reason it stays one. Kept here, not in relentless_rules.json, because that file is edited only by each key's owning package. selftest_relentless_wake checks every name resolves to a live key. kind: ceiling (bounds a process or worker that emits no event), throttle (cost or attention), window (a measurement span), cause_cap (an upper bound only: relentless_cause.sweep ends the wait the moment its recorded cause reads closed, at each tick and each wake serve; RELENTLESS_REWIRE_BACKOFFS_ON_CAUSE_CLOSE), wp11 (game lane, owned by RELENTLESS_LIVE_BUILD_ONE_AGENT_TWO_MODES).

stale_s.why: Deadman for a worker that has gone silent: silence emits no event to wake on. Measured journal 2026-10-31..11-06 (6.6 days, 751 ticks): 0 worker_stale ends; worker_lost 5 and checker_lost 17 were caught by the pid check, which is event-like already.

stop_quarantine_s.why: Already event-driven: each tick's fx.alive check releases the item the moment its process is gone. 600 s only bounds a process that will not die. Measured journal 2026-10-31..11-06 (6.6 days, 751 ticks): 8 quarantine alarms.

pool_parked_release_s.why: Clone retention, not a wait for work: a put-down row is released at 0 s already, so no item waits on this clock; it only keeps a parked clone warm for its own item's return. Nothing to wake on.

breaker_ack_min.why: Attention throttle on the owner-facing breaker alarm. Measured journal 2026-10-31..11-06 (6.6 days, 751 ticks): 15 breaker_emergency alarms; breaker.json opens {} at measurement time.

circling.help_cool_h.why: Cost throttle on paid fresh-eyes consults per item. Measured journal 2026-10-31..11-06 (6.6 days, 751 ticks): 64 help waits; the cool-down bounds repeat spend on one stuck item.

circling.help_wait_s.why: Upper bound on waiting for a helper's reply; the reply itself ends the wait (event). Measured journal 2026-10-31..11-06 (6.6 days, 751 ticks): 64 help waits.

staffing.hold_s.why: Length of the clean reading a staffing step needs before rising: a measurement span, not a pause before work.

unmeasured_recheck_s.why: Measured journal 2026-10-31..11-06 (6.6 days, 751 ticks): 109 unmeasured ends. Legacy route (reach_repair false) only. The recheck records the open item ids its blind reasons name (recheck_cause); relentless_cause.sweep re-checks the moment all of them close. A blind text naming no open item keeps only this clock.

breaker_cool_s.why: Breaker opens measured journal 2026-10-31..11-06 (6.6 days, 751 ticks) came from 'scratch_clone: FAILED: <path> already exists' and 'Permission denied (publickey)'. breaker.json records the cause; relentless_cause.sweep closes the breaker when the path is gone or a publish poke lands after the failure. Also the ledger start refusal's wait (start_again_cause): any wake poke after it ends it. An unclassified cause keeps this clock.

breaker_cool_max_s.why: Cap of breaker_cool_s; the same cause sweep ends an open breaker before either clock when its cause reads closed.

snag_again_wait_h.why: Repeat-snag backoff. The snag records the open item ids its detail names (not_before_cause); relentless_cause.sweep ends the wait when all of them close. A worker's own --wait-hours is time, kept a clock; a snag naming no open item keeps this clock.

game.prove_every_s.why: Game lane, owned by WP-11 (RELENTLESS_LIVE_BUILD_ONE_AGENT_TWO_MODES, relentless_game.py broker): its event conversion and measured reason are that package's, not this one's.
